relationships.subject: Capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: capsaicin stimulated nociceptors in the mouth via activating TRPV1

relationships.subject: SB366791
relationships.evidence_quote: SB366791 is a TRPV1 inhibitor demonstrated to work well when administered orally in rat models of pain

relationships.subject: NSAIDs
relationships.evidence_quote: NSAIDs are effective in reducing nociceptor sensitization and firing via their inhibition of cyclooxygenase (COX)

relationships.subject: Gabapentin
relationships.evidence_quote: Gabapentin works through inhibiting the α2δ-subunit of VGCCs

key_findings: Flies expressing human TRPV1 in nociceptors show pain-like behaviours and starvation death on capsaicin food, with viability dependent on capsaicin dose and TRPV1 copy number.
NSAIDs, gabapentin, antidepressants, GABA agonists and morphine, plus stj knockdown, increase viability, supporting conserved pain sensitization and descending modulation.
